name: feature-pack-billing
title: Billing Feature Pack
description: The feature-pack root for customer billing: the Billing Account template over Constructive plans, meters, credits, invoices, and the ledger.
docs:
`feature-pack-billing` installed the customer billing workspace and `.constructive/feature-packs/billing.json`. Import from `@/blocks/feature-packs/billing/billing-feature-pack`; it renders `BillingAccount` from `@/components/ui/billing-account`. The host passes `BillingAccountData` and the provider callbacks; add `console-module-billing` when Console Kit should own discovery and Constructive integration.

Degraded states: pass `views` to hide the views your data cannot back; missing callbacks leave their actions out.

Guide: https://constructive-io.github.io/blocks/blocks/features/billing/
